policy: Read-only research for the fixtures the featured method cannot resolve the way a featured pick is resolved (low tier, or not covered by e.g. Polymarket). HLTV first (identity, format, ranking context, and HLTV's own Betting block), then esportsbooks/exchanges via the companion runner sweep. Nothing here is a probability, a pick or an alias: no value is written into data/latest.json or data/origination.json. HLTV fan polls and Hotspawn community percentages are crowd polls, recorded only to show they were seen and excluded. Ranks are copied only where the segment read displayed them; anything not displayed is left blank, never inferred.

limitations_of_this_research: HLTV publishes no two-sided prematch price on these match pages: the Betting block is a sweepstake promotion, so HLTV can confirm identity/format/ranking context but can never originate a betting line here. HLTV fan polls were excluded by policy.

Ranks and lineups are dated observations (HLTV ranking week 2026-10-19 badges; lineups as displayed 2026-10-24). Stand-ins, roster changes after this read and map vetoes are unverified; two pages display 'Substitute' cells, copied verbatim.

The published percentages remain uncalibrated research-model estimates with the limitations shown on each match card. This dossier adds no probability and changes no pick; only a compliant two-sided external line, replayed by the ladder from saved first-party evidence, can upgrade a row.
Absence at this observation time is not proof that no market exists anywhere; books open closer to start time, which is why the four-hour pipeline retries every rung.

The target snapshot (2026-10-23T20:10:00Z) is itself stale because the four-hour publisher stalled on a wall-clock regression test (runs 40028653350-40063011446); fixtures Hotspawn added after that snapshot enter coverage only on the first successful refresh after the fix merges.
